fits: serious / explainer use cases (finance, B2B, healthcare)
hook_rules: Open on the cost of the problem, stated plainly in the first sentence. No throat-clearing, no 'in this video'. The viewer should feel the stakes within 2 seconds.
connector_rule: BUT / THEREFORE between every beat — never 'and then'. The mechanism beat especially: each step THEREFORE the next.
last_dab: End on the single defensible action, phrased so it loops back to the cost in the hook. Not 'follow for more'.

beats.purpose: name the expensive problem in one concrete sentence
make the pain specific and relatable — who it hits and how
explain how the fix actually works, step by step, no jargon
one credible number, result, or before/after that backs the mechanism
one clear next action and the single thing to remember
